positioning: The wild look with no wild blood. A spotted, athletic, dog-like cat from a lucky accident.
story: The Ocicat was an accident. In 1964, a breeder named Virginia Daly in Berkley, Michigan, crossed a Siamese with an Abyssinian-point Siamese, hoping to make a cat with Abyssinian markings and Siamese points. One kitten in the litter had an ivory coat with golden spots, and Daly's daughter said it looked like a baby ocelot. The name stuck.

The Ocicat has no wild blood. It is entirely domestic, a result of Siamese, Abyssinian and later American Shorthair lines, and the American Shorthair introduced the silver color and the larger bone. Despite the look, the breed is a sociable, friendly house cat.

The coat is the signature. A short, sleek coat is covered in thumbprint-shaped spots, arranged in a bull's-eye pattern, with a mark that looks like an M on the forehead. Each hair has several bands of color, which gives a glowing look, and the colors include tawny, chocolate, cinnamon, blue, lavender and silver.

The body is solid and muscular, athletic and graceful, with a long, powerful frame and a broad head. The eyes are almond-shaped and can be any color except blue. An Ocicat moves like a small wild cat, and it is often mistaken for one.

The personality is that of a dog. Ocicats are outgoing, intelligent and social, and they can learn tricks, to fetch and to walk on a leash. They greet guests at the door and follow their people. They have a soft voice, and they get on well with children, dogs and other cats.

The coat needs a weekly rub with a soft cloth. Health notes include PK deficiency, kidney problems and dental disease, so ask breeders about screening. An Ocicat does best with company and tall climbing places. A healthy Ocicat can live twelve to eighteen years.

last_walk:
Orange light on the leaf pile, and the porch lamps are coming on.
The Ocicat has greeted, fetched and followed all week. Now it sits in the autumn leaves, spots gleaming, and watches the dusk fall. One more look at the street, then supper.
